Name: Ultimate Guide To Clowning
Author: PossiblyClown
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=4][center]Hello, this mod doesn't do anything on it's own! 
It's a guide book that will conditionally add chapters based on what mods of mine you have installed.
The following mods are currently supported:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34440]The Wayfarer Remastered[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37293]The Collector (Beta)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36745]Arcanian Reserve

[/url]Make sure to check the Configuration file to toggle between tilesheet recolors. 
Currently there is a recolor for the wayfarer by  [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303]BogWyytch[/url]﻿[/center][/size][/color]
